Preferences:

- They plan to add “Amistad” and “Hotel Rwanda” to their list.

- Historical drama: interested in lavish period pieces, royal intrigue/politics, romance, action, and well-developed characters.

- “Victoria” appeals as a more traditional, lavish royal period drama; “The Last Kingdom” appeals as a more action-packed historical adventure involving Anglo-Saxon politics and Vikings.
